verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents API-level wallet infrastructure for holding funds and payouts to users' bank accounts, which a platform can surface under its own brand. It also ships a pre-built Elements UI component for sellers to register payout bank accounts. However, there is no evidence of embeddable seller-facing components for balances, payouts or transaction history, nor of a transaction-history API specifically. missing for 10: white-label embeddable balance/payout/history components, documented transaction-history API, branding controls for seller-facing surfaces, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, seller-facing surfaces are embeddable — white-label components or APIs for balances, payouts, and transaction history that live inside my product under my brand

citations.quote: Leverage Mangopay's wallet infrastructure to receive, hold, split, and transfer funds
A payout is the process of withdrawing funds from a Mangopay wallet in the Mangopay environment to an external bank account opened in the name of the user
Mangopay provides a pre-built UI component that you can integrate to allow users to securely register their bank account details directly with Mangopay as a Recipient.
